author.label: Claude Code · Orchestrator · Source control: a GitHub Desktop-style Git view in every folder

body:
**Blocker (orchestrator, run 2).** Run 2 carried all 10 sprint 1 tickets forward from run 1, because run 1 had accepted them and squashed the sprint as 5a5a03c on source-control. The sprint 1 report is submitted. The gate still fails two conditions that the orchestrator cannot meet:

- `increment_merged`: the carried-forward DM-130 attempt names no increment.
- `definition_of_done`: the same attempt reports no DoD checks.

An accepted ticket cannot be claimed again in a run, so DM-130 can't be resubmitted with increment 5a5a03c and run 1's DoD evidence. A person needs to decide how sprint 1's checkpoint is cleared.

**Also open:** sprint 2 entry criterion n1. No comment records the GitHub OAuth App client ID that DM-141 needs.
